create_Link_instance: create a Link instance with an optional history file path to connect with Dora
load_Link_history: load the history from a JSON file into the Link instance with retry logic
update_Link_history: update the Link history with a list of metric dictionaries and commit to disk
push_Link_metrics: push a single metrics dictionary to the Link history and commit to disk
review_Link_class: review the Link class and its methods for managing Dora experiment history
